segments.sn9.2:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ aññataro bhikkhu kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe.
segments.sn9.2:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena so bhikkhu divāvihāragato supati.
segments.sn9.2:1.3: Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tassa bhikkhuno anukampikā atthakāmā taṃ bhikkhuṃ saṃvejetukāmā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn9.2:2.1: “Uṭṭhehi bhikkhu kiṃ sesi, ko attho supitena [supinena (sī.)] te;
segments.sn9.2:2.3: Āturassa hi kā niddā, sallaviddhassa ruppato.
segments.sn9.2:3.1: “Yāya saddhāya pabbajito [yāya saddhāpabbajito (sī. syā. kaṃ.)], agārasmānagāriyaṃ;
segments.sn9.2:3.3: Tameva saddhaṃ brūhehi, mā niddāya vasaṃ gamī”ti.
segments.sn9.2:4.3: Baddhesu [khandhesu (sī.)] muttaṃ asitaṃ, kasmā pabbajitaṃ tape.
segments.sn9.2:5.3: Taṃ ñāṇaṃ paramodānaṃ [pariyodātaṃ (sī. pī.), paramodātaṃ (syā. kaṃ.), paramavodānaṃ (sī. aṭṭha.)], kasmā pabbajitaṃ tape.
segments.sn9.2:6.1: “Chetvā [bhetvā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] avijjaṃ vijjāya, āsavānaṃ parikkhayā;

lines: Dutiye supatīti ayaṃ kira khīṇāsavo, so dūre bhikkhācāragāmaṃ gantvā āgato paṇṇasālāya pattacīvaraṃ paṭisāmetvā avidūre jātassaraṃ otaritvā gattāni utuṃ gāhāpetvā divāṭṭhānaṃ sammajjitvā tattha nīcamañcakaṃ paññāpetvā niddaṃ anokkamantova nipanno.
Khīṇāsavassāpi hi kāyadaratho hotiyevāti tassa vinodanatthaṃ, taṃ sandhāya supatīti vuttaṃ.
Ajjhabhāsīti “ayaṃ bhikkhu satthu santike kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahetvā divā supati, divāsoppañca nāmetaṃ vaḍḍhitaṃ diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikaṃ atthaṃ nāsetī”ti maññamānā “codessāmi nan”ti cintetvā abhāsi.
Āturassāti jarāturo rogāturo kilesāturoti tayo āturā, tesu kilesāturaṃ sandhāyevamāha.
Sallaviddhassāti savisena sattisallena viya avijjāvisaviṭṭhena taṇhāsallena hadaye viddhassa.
Kasmā pabbajitaṃ tapeti evarūpaṃ khīṇāsavaṃ divāsoppaṃ na tapati, tādisaṃ pana kasmā na tapessatīti?
Therasseva vā etaṃ vacanaṃ, tasmā ayamettha attho – baddhesu muttaṃ asitaṃ mādisaṃ khīṇāsavapabbajitaṃ kasmā divāsoppaṃ tape, na tapessatīti?
“evarūpaṃ khīṇāsavapabbajitaṃ divāsoppaṃ na tapati, tādisaṃ pana kasmā na tapessati?
Upariṭṭhatāya parito dīghaputhulatāya ativiya vijjhatīti sattisallaggahaṇaṃ.
Avijjāya pana sammohāpādanena dukkhāpādanena ca visasadisatā.
Pabbajitanti sasantānato pabbajitaṃ vā rāgādimalato pabbajitaṃ vā.
Tasmāti yasmā therassevetaṃ vacanaṃ, tasmā ayaṃ idāni vuccamāno ettha gāthāya attho.
Vinayāti hetumhi nissakkavacananti tassa hetumhi karaṇavacanena atthamāha “vinayenā”ti.
